# adiabatic.garden

Yoyo's site.

## site links
- https://adiabatic.garden/ - the landing page, linking to writing and about. all writing pages were originally written in .md and thus could have .md appended to lower token costs
- https://adiabatic.garden/about/ - basic information
- https://adiabatic.garden/pages/bookshelf.md - books I like
- https://adiabatic.garden/pages/blog-roll.md - some blogs I like
- https://adiabatic.garden/pages/rwx.md/ - my process of building researching and philosophizing
- https://adiabatic.garden/writing hardware built, not that important, include:
  - https://adiabatic.garden/long/laser-cutter
  - https://adiabatic.garden/long/microdrones
  - https://adiabatic.garden/long/swarm-mapping
- https://github.com/exanova-y - github

## about this site
this site uses raw HTML, CSS and JS. Posts are written in markdown and displayed using 11ty. A tree structure borrowed from forester is re-implemented in JS. Each page shows related bookmarks fetched from curius in text-embedding-3-small by cosine similarity, keeping matches > 0.6. The homepage uses colours from a Zed Nu Disco theme. The site is hosted on cloudflare
